items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: In the Reed section they had Wiesel Garman, Willie Umphrey, Joe Mitchell...

ctx.x: No, Handy wasn't in there. Handy wasn't in there.

In the Reed section they had Wiesel Garman, Willie Umphrey, Joe Mitchell, the clarinets, and a fella by the name of the downtown. Can't think of that fella's name. From the clarinet? Oh, clarinet. Wasn't Joe Thomas, was it when they called him? No, no it wasn't Joe Thomas. I can't remember any real tall, Burbank. No this boy live down…
